_platform_source: Steam and Epic PC title; the mod is a .NET assembly loaded into the Windows build
_ap_world_name_source: our own world: TerraTechWorld.game = "TerraTech" in worlds/terratech/__init__.py
description: Every block locked until the multiworld sends you the right to use it. 1144 blocks, all of them items.
_description_source: written by us -- this is our own world
_checks_verified_note: Generation is proven (4 goals, 5 seeds, 4-player multiworld). Nobody has PLAYED it yet.
_requires_source: a commercial game the player buys on Steam or Epic
_mod_kind_source: the commercial release, not a remake

client.name: TerraTech Client
client._kind_source: our world registers its own client as a LauncherComponents Component; it holds the AP session and talks to the game mod over TCP 24601. London launches it and stands aside.
client._protocol_source: no emulator memory protocol is involved -- the mod runs inside the game's own process

_install_kind_source: two pieces: terratech.apworld into custom_worlds, and TerraTechArchipelago.zip into the game's QMods folder. London can place both.
setup: Download terratech.apworld and TerraTechArchipelago.zip from the release.
Put terratech.apworld in Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Start the TerraTech Client from the Archipelago launcher, then start a new campaign.

patch._source: no ROM, no patching -- a managed assembly loaded at runtime

_patch_extension_source: our own world defines no APPatchExtension

credits._note: TerraTech is Payload Studios' and is never distributed here; the player buys their own copy. The Archipelago world, the game mod and this plugin are all solida1987's -- this is a London exclusive.
